REPLAYSGLOBAL DEBUTA first-of-its-kind competition.The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic brought together current and former pro football players, elite global athletes, and the reigning World IFAF Champions TEAM USA FOOTBALL® in Los Angeles for a first-of-its-kind competition. Hosted at BMO Stadium, the future Olympic venue for flag football in 2028, the event highlighted the growth of the game and the pathway to the highest level of competition.GAME RESULTS & REPLAYSREP TEAM USA FOOTBALL® GEARStars Meet ChampionsA world-class showdown between pro football stars and the most accomplished flag football players in the world.TEAM USA FOOTBALL®Captains: Aamir Brown & Darrell “Housh” DoucetteCoach: Jorge CascudoAssistant Coach: Rudy FernandezVIEW ROSTERFOUNDERS FFCCaptains: Tom Brady & Jalen HurtsCoach: Sean PaytonDefensive Specialist: Robert SalehVIEW ROSTERWILDCATS FFCCaptain: Jayden Daniels & Joe BurrowCoach: Kyle ShanahanDefensive Specialist: Robert SalehVIEW ROSTERGAME CENTER ROUND-ROBIN GAME 1 | FINAL TEAM USA FOOTBALL® 39 WILDCATS FFC 14 GAME STATS | WATCH REPLAY ROUND-ROBIN GAME 2 | FINAL TEAM USA FOOTBALL® 43 FOUNDERS FFC 16 GAME STATS | WATCH REPLAY CHAMPIONSHIP GAME | FINAL TEAM USA FOOTBALL® 24 WILDCATS FFC 14 GAME STATS | WATCH REPLAY Press CenterESPNTom Brady shines, but Team USA dominates flag football.READ MORENBC SPORTSTeam USA wins inaugural Fanatics Flag Football Classic.READ MORECBS SPORTSTeam USA dominates Tom Brady, Joe Burrow and other NFL stars.READ MOREUSA TODAYTeam USA dominates exhibition.READ MOREOne family of teams representing the U.S. in elite competitions.
